message.content:
**Short answer:**  
Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s usually handled by the **Atlanta Police Department (APD)** or the city’s **Code Enforcement** office rather than the city council itself. The council can refer you to the proper department, but they don’t take individual noise complaints directly.

---

## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call |
|------|------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Call 311** (or 404‑656‑3111) | 311 is Atlanta’s non-emergency hotline. It will route your call to the right department. |
| 2 | **Use the online portal** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov> → “Services” → “Noise Complaint.” You’ll fill out a form with details (time, location, description). |
| 3 | **Contact APD directly** | If the noise is urgent or you prefer to speak to a dispatcher: 404‑656‑3111 (non‑emergency) or 404‑656‑3111 (for 311). |
| 4 | **Check the Code Enforcement office** | For ongoing or repeated violations, you can also reach out to the City’s Code Enforcement: 404‑656‑3111 (non‑emergency) or via the online portal. |

### Key Points

- **Noise Ordinance**: Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 5 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on sound levels and defines prohibited times (e.g., 10 p.m.–6 a.m.).  
- **Documentation**: When filing, provide as much detail as possible—exact time, location, type of noise, and any witnesses.  
- **Follow‑up**: After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. You can track the status online or call 311 for updates.  

---

## Why the City Council Isn’t the Direct Channel

- The **City Council** sets policy and passes ordinances, but day‑to‑day enforcement is delegated to the **Police Department** and **Code Enforcement**.  
- If you’re dissatisfied with how a complaint is handled, you can bring it to the council’s attention during a public meeting or through a written request, but the council will typically refer you back to the enforcement agency.

---

## Quick Contact List

| Agency | Phone | Online |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Atlanta Police Department (Non‑Emergency) | 404‑656‑3111 | https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/atlantapolice |
| City of Atlanta 311 | 404‑656‑3111 | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| Code Enforcement | 404‑656‑3111 | https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/codeenforcement |
| City of Atlanta – Noise Complaint Form | – | https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/noisecomplaint |

---

### Bottom Line

- **Yes, you can report noise** in Atlanta.  
- Use **311**, the **online portal**, or call the **APD**.  
- The **city council** can’t take the complaint directly but can help if you need to address enforcement issues.  

If you need more specific guidance (e.g., how to file a formal complaint, what evidence to gather), let me know!
